_readme: Nguon du lieu cho trang Danh gia khach hang (/lookbook.html va /en/lookbook.html). Sua file nay roi chay: python3 tools/build-customer-feedback.py. Luat day du o dau file tools/build-customer-feedback.py. Truong 'topics' chi duoc gan khi chinh loi danh gia nhac tu khoa trong 'topic_keywords' (script tu kiem). Chi hien danh gia co verification='verified' hoac 'owner-verified' va reuse='approved'. Eyezen la nhom rieng (khong phai da trong). Chi nhac 'Essilor' khong du de gan Varilux/Eyezen. Ban cong khai: chi giu du lieu generator can. Ho so kiem chung noi bo (email, ma thread, ghi chu kiem toan, danh gia dang giu) KHONG dua vao repo nay.

google_reviews.name: Lola Scheiner

It is my first time trying multi focal glasses. Alvin welcomed me and with extreme patience expanded all the options I have.
I was taken upstairs to a very clean and professional eye check and were given out prescription.
I tried almost 25 different frames until o was happy and now I have my very first multi-focals at an exceptional price!
Thank you Alvin !
